text: Select: activity_id, molecule_chembl_id, target_chembl_id, target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, molecule_dictionary, target_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND activities.toid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter: target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND activities.standard_units = 'nM' AND activities.standard_type IN ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50') AND activities.standard_value < 50. Sort: activity_id ASC. Limit: 200.
